description: Meet the Ninja® Double Oven, the countertop oven that unlocks the power of two ovens in the counter space of one. Only Ninja has the FlexDoor™ that creates 2 separate ovens so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways at different temperatures and cooking times. Use just the Top Rapid Oven for quick snacks, sides, and sheet pan meals—or the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven for larger roasts, bakes, or air frying up to 6 lbs of wings. You can also sync both independent ovens to cook a full course meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. While your meal cooks, FlavorSeal technology prevents flavor crossover between ovens. Two oven cavities in one eliminate back-to-back cooking for 65% faster meal-making than your traditional oven so you can put your wall oven out of business. Plus, this countertop dual oven features 14 cooking functions for the ultimate versatility. Access just the top for quick meals and snacks, or open the full door so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways on the top and bottom. FlavorSeal Technology prevents smells from crossing between ovens, so your flavors stay separate. SmartFinish™ technology syncs both independent ovens to cook 2 meals, 2 different ways that finish at the same time. Eliminate back-to-back cooking for 65% faster meal-making than your traditional oven. 14 cooking functions. Bake, broil, reheat, keep warm, bagel, toast, and cookies in the Top Rapid Oven. Air fry, convection bake, pizza, air roast, whole roast, dehydrate, and proof in the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven. Family-sized capacity to feed up to 8 people. Two independent ovens let you cook a meal for the kids and a separate meal for the parents at the same time for easy family dinners. Sync both ovens to cook a full meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. nom: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew 2-Way Single Serve Coffee Maker
description: No two coffee drinkers are the same so when you make coffee at home, the flexibility to customize how and what you brew is key. From fresh grounds to K-Cup®* pods, the FlexBrew® 2-Way Coffee Maker gives you the options to please fans of all types of coffees. TWO WAYS TO BREW. Brew a full pot using your favorite grounds on the carafe side, or make a cup for yourself using a K-Cup®* pod or grounds on the single-serve side with this 2-in-1 coffee maker. The Hamilton Beach FlexBrew 2-Way Coffee Maker has the option to please fans of all types of coffees and quantities, making it the perfect gift for a home with multiple coffee drinkers. description: Two delicious coffees from fresh beans, with ease, thanks to the intuitive touch display. Enjoy the delicious taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans, at the perfect temperature, thanks to our intelligent brewing system. description: Even more aroma for even more enjoyment The Professional Aroma Grinder helps to create the perfect coffee that is second to none. The ultimate solution for cappuccino lovers. Sustainable design With its quiet elegance, the design of the E6 reflects the unique technology hidden behind its timeless exterior. The linear geometry with sophisticated chrome accents ensures a distinct visual that focuses uncompromisingly on first-class coffee and blends harmoniously into any décor. Both in terms of the selection of specialties and its design, the E6 purposely avoids any excess that could distract from its true essence: The perfect cup of coffee. Accessories Included: Jura Starter Kit User Manual Product Features: Professional Aroma Grinder grinds fresh, whole beans and ensures more aromatic coffee through more consistent grinding. Fine Foam Frother prepares fine, compact milk foam making it possible to prepare trend specialties to professional barista standards. The milk system should be cleaned daily using the included container when preparing milk specialties. The milk system can also be rinsed intermittently in between preparations. This versatile machine can also deliver hot water on demand for tea or Americano, with three programmable hot water temperatures. description: Make fresh, healthy juice in seconds with the Hamilton Beach® Professional Super Chute™ Easy Clean Juice Extractor. The 3.5" Super Chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting to save time and the Easy Sweep™ tool cuts strainer cleaning time in half. Accessories Included: Easy Sweep cleaning tool 34 ounce pitcher with foam separator on its lid Product Features: MAKE FRESH, HEALTHY JUICE IN SECONDS. Juicing at home is a fast, fun way to get your daily nutrients. Make juice with classic produce such as oranges, apples and carrots, or create on-trend juice blends with celery, ginger, kale, spinach and beets. SAVES TIME — 3.5" SUPER CHUTE. The extra-large feed chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting and fits a whole apple, peeled orange or handful of kale. You'll enjoy fast, continuous juicing and the large pulp bin lets you juice more and empty less. EASY TO CLEAN — PATENTED EASY SWEEP™ CLEANING TOOL. The Easy Sweep™ cleaning tool sweeps the strainer clean in one simple motion, cutting the strainer cleaning time of this juicer machine in half. The BPA-free pitcher, lid, pulp bin, cleaning tool and pusher go in the dishwasher for fast, easy cleanup. MAKES 16 OZ. OF JUICE IN JUST 10 SECONDS. Why buy juice when you can make your own in 10 seconds flat? The powerful 1100 watt dual-speed motor of this juice extractor gives you faster juicing and provides maximum juice yield. ENJOY DELICIOUS, FOAM-FREE JUICE. The large 34 oz. pitcher of this fruit and vegetable juicer has a froth separator on its lid so you'll pour clear, foam-free juice into your glass. nom: Winix C909 4-Stage Air Purifier with Wi-Fi & PlasmaWave Technology
description: Featuring a 4-stage air purification system, this unit removes 99.99% of airborne particles as small as 0.003 microns in size. Winix’s PlasmaWave® Technology may help to reduce the presence of airborne pollutants and contaminants. The unit’s built-in Smart Sensors detect and monitor the quality of air in your environment and provides a visual representation of your current air quality. When in Auto Mode, the unit automatically adjusts fan speeds to ensure efficient and cost-effective cleaning. Sleep mode is automatically activated when the room is darkened, providing quiet, energy-efficient operation. The WiFi feature allows you to connect your air purifier to the Winix Smart App and monitor the air quality in your home, control your air purifier, and track filter life. Accessories Included: Two Genuine Winix True HEPA Filter sets included for up to 24 months normal usage Product Features: AHAM Verifide® at 500 sq ft.: Also cleans rooms up to 2,420 sq ft in 1 hour (1,210 sq ft in 30 minutes, 807 sq ft in 20 minutes, 605 sq ft in 15 minutes) The Smarter Air Purifier: Control and monitor your unit anytime from anywhere by instantly accessing your unit with the Winix Smart App through the convenient WiFi feature Washable Fine Mesh Pre-Filter: The first line of defense against the largest airborne particles found indoors Activated Carbon Filter: Reduces VOCs and household odors from cooking, pets, and smoke. It is designed to catch airborne particles found indoors, which also helps prolong the True HEPA Filter life True HEPA Filter: Winix True HEPA captures 99.99%* of airborne allergens including pollen, dust, smoke, pet dander, and other ultrafine particles as small as 0.003 microns *Based on independent laboratory tests conducted on inanimate particles as small as 0.003 microns in size. Accessories Included: Jura Starter Kit User Manual Product Features: Professional Aroma Grinder grinds fresh, whole beans and ensures more aromatic coffee through more consistent grinding. nom: Philips 800 Series Automatic Espresso Machine
description: Two delicious coffees from fresh beans, with ease, thanks to the intuitive touch display. Enjoy the delicious taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans, at the perfect temperature, thanks to our intelligent brewing system. The classic milk frother allows you to create a silky-smooth cappuccino or latte macchiato with ease. Accessories Included: Grease tube Measuring scoop Water hardness test strip Product Features: Coffee from fresh beans – easily make delicious coffee drinks from fresh beans, exactly the way you like it, with the touch of a button. Automatic descaling for your convenience - it is easy to clean and maintain your coffee machine with the automatic program which notifies when you have to descale it. You can adjust the frequency of this procedure to match the water hardness at home. Adjust aroma strength and quantity via My Coffee Choice - adjust the strength and quantity of your beverage with the My Coffee Choice menu. Easily choose from three different settings to suit your preferences. Dishwasher safe parts for your convenience - for your convenience, you can put the milk system, drip tray and the coffee ground container in the dishwasher. This will save time and ensure a hygienic cleaning. Easy cleaning thanks to fully removable brew group - the brew group is the heart of every fully automatic coffee machine and should be cleaned regularly. The removable brew group allows you to clean it thoroughly just by rinsing it under the tap. Easy selection of your coffee with intuitive touch display - The irresistible taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans is just one touch away. Our intuitive touch display allows you to easily select your favorite coffee. 20,000 cups of finest coffee with durable ceramic grinders - Bring out the full flavor of your coffee with our hard-wearing ceramic grinder. Our sharp-edged grinders extract the best aroma and flavor from your beans. Made from 100% ceramic material which ensures they last for at least 20,000 cups. Easily adjust to your taste with 12-step grinder levels - our durable ceramic grinders can be adjusted in 12 steps, so you can turn your beans into anything from ultra-fine powder to coarse grindings. The perfect temperature, aroma and crema cup after cup – the Aroma extract system intelligently strikes the optimum balance between brewing temperature and aroma extraction by keeping the water temperature between 194°F and 208°F, while regulating the water flow rate, so you can enjoy delicious coffees. Up to 5,000 cups without descaling thanks to AquaClean water filter* – by changing the filter after being prompted by the machine, you will not need to descale your machine for up to 5,000 cups**, while enjoying clear and purified water. *AquaClean filter compatible; not included. Sold separately. **Based on 8 filters replacement as indicated by the machine. Actual number of cups depends on selected coffee varieties, rinsing and cleaning patterns. Digital Display Screen: Just insert any K-Cup® pod and use the simple interface to brew a delicious cup. Compatible with the My K-Cup® Universal Reusable Coffee Filter: Brew your own ground coffee (sold separately). nom: Hamilton Beach Professional Super Chute Easy Clean Juice Extractor
description: Make fresh, healthy juice in seconds with the Hamilton Beach® Professional Super Chute™ Easy Clean Juice Extractor. The 3.5" Super Chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting to save time and the Easy Sweep™ tool cuts strainer cleaning time in half. Accessories Included: Easy Sweep cleaning tool 34 ounce pitcher with foam separator on its lid Product Features: MAKE FRESH, HEALTHY JUICE IN SECONDS. Juicing at home is a fast, fun way to get your daily nutrients. Make juice with classic produce such as oranges, apples and carrots, or create on-trend juice blends with celery, ginger, kale, spinach and beets. SAVES TIME — 3.5" SUPER CHUTE. The extra-large feed chute virtually eliminates pre-cutting and fits a whole apple, peeled orange or handful of kale. You'll enjoy fast, continuous juicing and the large pulp bin lets you juice more and empty less. EASY TO CLEAN — PATENTED EASY SWEEP™ CLEANING TOOL. The Easy Sweep™ cleaning tool sweeps the strainer clean in one simple motion, cutting the strainer cleaning time of this juicer machine in half. The BPA-free pitcher, lid, pulp bin, cleaning tool and pusher go in the dishwasher for fast, easy cleanup. MAKES 16 OZ. OF JUICE IN JUST 10 SECONDS. Why buy juice when you can make your own in 10 seconds flat? The powerful 1100 watt dual-speed motor of this juice extractor gives you faster juicing and provides maximum juice yield. ENJOY DELICIOUS, FOAM-FREE JUICE. The large 34 oz. pitcher of this fruit and vegetable juicer has a froth separator on its lid so you'll pour clear, foam-free juice into your glass. Dimensions & More Info: Type of material made from: Plastic and metal 9.5” L x 16.7” W x 17.2” H 15.5 lbs 1100-Watts Made in China Warranty: Can be found on pg-12 of the Use and Care Guide. Parts/Labor: 5-year limited warranty

nom: MRCOOL E Star DIY 4th Gen 18k BTU Ductless Mini-Split Heat Pump Complete System 208-230V/60Hz
description: The MRCOOL 4th Generation DIY 18K BTU, 22 SEER Ductless Heat Pump system offers a complete solution to your home’s heating and cooling needs. This system can heat & cool an area up to 750 sq. ft and is capable of an Energy Star certified, 22 SEER efficiency rating. However, the best feature of this system is the ease of installation it provides to the homeowner. With the included pre-charged 25 ft. line set, some hand tools, and a few hours of time this entire system can be completely installed. This system comes equipped with many functions that separate it from the rest. It has multiple operating modes, which include AUTO, HEAT, COOL, FAN-ONLY, DRY (dehumidification) and SLEEP. It also features the Follow Me function, which allows the system to continually adjust the room temperature based on where the hand-held remote controller is. Need to operate the system when you’re not at home? No problem. The MRCOOL system also has the capability of being operated with your smartphone with the use of the Smart HVAC app. MRCOOL stands behind the quality and workmanship of this system by being the only manufacturer to offer a limited lifetime compressor warranty. nom: Winix C909 4-Stage Air Purifier with Wi-Fi & PlasmaWave Technology
description: Featuring a 4-stage air purification system, this unit removes 99.99% of airborne particles as small as 0.003 microns in size. Winix’s PlasmaWave® Technology may help to reduce the presence of airborne pollutants and contaminants. The unit’s built-in Smart Sensors detect and monitor the quality of air in your environment and provides a visual representation of your current air quality. When in Auto Mode, the unit automatically adjusts fan speeds to ensure efficient and cost-effective cleaning. Sleep mode is automatically activated when the room is darkened, providing quiet, energy-efficient operation. The WiFi feature allows you to connect your air purifier to the Winix Smart App and monitor the air quality in your home, control your air purifier, and track filter life. Accessories Included: Two Genuine Winix True HEPA Filter sets included for up to 24 months normal usage Product Features: AHAM Verifide® at 500 sq ft.: Also cleans rooms up to 2,420 sq ft in 1 hour (1,210 sq ft in 30 minutes, 807 sq ft in 20 minutes, 605 sq ft in 15 minutes) The Smarter Air Purifier: Control and monitor your unit anytime from anywhere by instantly accessing your unit with the Winix Smart App through the convenient WiFi feature Washable Fine Mesh Pre-Filter: The first line of defense against the largest airborne particles found indoors Activated Carbon Filter: Reduces VOCs and household odors from cooking, pets, and smoke. It is designed to catch airborne particles found indoors, which also helps prolong the True HEPA Filter life True HEPA Filter: Winix True HEPA captures 99.99%* of airborne allergens including pollen, dust, smoke, pet dander, and other ultrafine particles as small as 0.003 microns *Based on independent laboratory tests conducted on inanimate particles as small as 0.003 microns in size. PlasmaWave® Air Cleaning Technology: May help to reduce the presence of airborne impurities Air Quality Indicator: Visual indicator displays real-time air quality in the room with LED lights 2 Year Filter Supply: Includes 2 True HEPA replacement filters and 8 Activated Carbon Filters Dual Smart Sensors + Auto Mode: Built-in air quality sensor measures and adjusts fan speed in real-time Ultra-Quiet: Nearly silent on slowest speed (25 dB) Light Automated Sleep Mode: Unit automatically activates its quiet, energy-efficient Sleep Mode when room is darkened and returns to Auto Mode in the presence of light Tested and Trusted: This unit is proven dependable and efficient by being AHAM Verified, Energy Star Certified, and UL Certified Energy Efficient: Energy Star Certified for low energy consumption, resulting in reduced operating costs Filter Replacement Indicator: When the filters need to be replaced, the Filter Replacement Indicator LED will illuminate Dimensions & More Info: Material: ABS and EPS plastic Voltage: 120 Hertz: 60 Watts: 95 (sleep 7W, low 10W, medium 19W, high 28W, turbo 90) Decibels: (Low/Med/High/Turbo) Sleep 25, Low 30, Medium 38, High 41, Turbo 52 16.5” L x 11.4” W x 23.2” H; Weight: 17.2 lbs Made in Thailand Warranty: 2 Years Manufacturers’ Warranty For product related questions please contact Winix America at 1-877-699-4649, or 1-847-551-9900

description: Meet the Ninja® Double Oven, the countertop oven that unlocks the power of two ovens in the counter space of one. Only Ninja has the FlexDoor™ that creates 2 separate ovens so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways at different temperatures and cooking times. Use just the Top Rapid Oven for quick snacks, sides, and sheet pan meals—or the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven for larger roasts, bakes, or air frying up to 6 lbs of wings. You can also sync both independent ovens to cook a full course meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. While your meal cooks, FlavorSeal technology prevents flavor crossover between ovens. Two oven cavities in one eliminate back-to-back cooking for 65% faster meal-making than your traditional oven so you can put your wall oven out of business. Plus, this countertop dual oven features 14 cooking functions for the ultimate versatility. Access just the top for quick meals and snacks, or open the full door so you can cook 2 meals, 2 ways on the top and bottom. FlavorSeal Technology prevents smells from crossing between ovens, so your flavors stay separate. SmartFinish™ technology syncs both independent ovens to cook 2 meals, 2 different ways that finish at the same time. Air fry, convection bake, pizza, air roast, whole roast, dehydrate, and proof in the Bottom Convection & Air Fry Oven. Family-sized capacity to feed up to 8 people. Two independent ovens let you cook a meal for the kids and a separate meal for the parents at the same time for easy family dinners. Sync both ovens to cook a full meal that finishes cooking at the same time with Smart Finish™ technology. description: Introducing the Frigidaire Nugget Ice Maker. Say goodbye to tough ice cubes and elevate your beverage experience with chewable nugget ice. These unique clear, soft, yet crunchy nuggets float effortlessly in your favorite beverages, delivering a refreshing and enjoyable drinking experience. With its high ice production capacity of up to 33 lbs. in a day, you'll never run out of ice for your drinks. The first nugget of ice is ready in just 10-15 minutes, allowing you to enjoy your chilled beverages without delay. In approximately 150 minutes, the ice maker reaches its full ice capacity, ensuring you always have a plentiful supply on hand. The push-button control panel makes operation a breeze.  Operating within a temperature range of 10-40 ℃, this ice maker is versatile and adaptable to different environments. An indicator is included to alert you of water shortage or when the ice basket is full, ensuring a hassle-free ice-making process. The sleek stainless steel finish adds a touch of sophistication to your kitchen or bar area. Upgrade your beverage experience with the Frigidaire Nugget Ice Maker, and enjoy chewable ice in your drinks anytime, anywhere. description: The MRCOOL 4th Generation DIY 18K BTU, 22 SEER Ductless Heat Pump system offers a complete solution to your home’s heating and cooling needs. This system can heat & cool an area up to 750 sq. ft and is capable of an Energy Star certified, 22 SEER efficiency rating. However, the best feature of this system is the ease of installation it provides to the homeowner. With the included pre-charged 25 ft. line set, some hand tools, and a few hours of time this entire system can be completely installed. This system comes equipped with many functions that separate it from the rest. It has multiple operating modes, which include AUTO, HEAT, COOL, FAN-ONLY, DRY (dehumidification) and SLEEP. It also features the Follow Me function, which allows the system to continually adjust the room temperature based on where the hand-held remote controller is. Need to operate the system when you’re not at home? No problem. The MRCOOL system also has the capability of being operated with your smartphone with the use of the Smart HVAC app. MRCOOL stands behind the quality and workmanship of this system by being the only manufacturer to offer a limited lifetime compressor warranty. description: Even more aroma for even more enjoyment The Professional Aroma Grinder helps to create the perfect coffee that is second to none. Thanks to perfected grinder geometry, the quality of the grind is more consistent, and this performance is maintained over its entire service life. This optimizes aroma extraction and achieves an aroma increase of 12.2% compared to conventional grinders. Discover completely new sides to your favorite coffee specialty. Cappuccino made to perfection With the proven Easy Cappuccino function, you can enjoy superb cappuccino at the touch of a button. The milk nozzle, which was specially developed for cappuccino, ensures uniquely soft, fine milk foam that perfectly complements the coffee and promises true perfection. The ultimate solution for cappuccino lovers. Perfection made easy The clearly presented 2.8" color display, six ideally placed buttons and an intuitive operating concept enable convenient operation of the E6, whether you want simple coffee preparation, to set individual preferences or use the self-explanatory cleaning functions. The E6 is also compatible with J.O.E.®, which allows you to prepare specialty coffees, set and store personal preferences and easily send your guests' coffee orders directly to the coffee machine from your smartphone. Sustainable design With its quiet elegance, the design of the E6 reflects the unique technology hidden behind its timeless exterior. The linear geometry with sophisticated chrome accents ensures a distinct visual that focuses uncompromisingly on first-class coffee and blends harmoniously into any décor. Both in terms of the selection of specialties and its design, the E6 purposely avoids any excess that could distract from its true essence: The perfect cup of coffee. Accessories Included: Jura Starter Kit User Manual Product Features: Professional Aroma Grinder grinds fresh, whole beans and ensures more aromatic coffee through more consistent grinding. Fine Foam Frother prepares fine, compact milk foam making it possible to prepare trend specialties to professional barista standards. The milk system should be cleaned daily using the included container when preparing milk specialties. The milk system can also be rinsed intermittently in between preparations. This versatile machine can also deliver hot water on demand for tea or Americano, with three programmable hot water temperatures. Holds 10 oz. of fresh, whole beans and has an aroma preservation lid to keep beans fresh to guarantee a fresh cup of coffee every time. The 64 oz. water tank is front loading and has an RFID chip which communicates with the CLEARYL Smart filter and advises the uses when it’s time to be replaced. The CLEARYL Smart filter maintains water purity as part of the brand’s commitment to maximizing quality and taste. nom: Philips 800 Series Automatic Espresso Machine
description: Two delicious coffees from fresh beans, with ease, thanks to the intuitive touch display. Enjoy the delicious taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans, at the perfect temperature, thanks to our intelligent brewing system. The classic milk frother allows you to create a silky-smooth cappuccino or latte macchiato with ease. Accessories Included: Grease tube Measuring scoop Water hardness test strip Product Features: Coffee from fresh beans – easily make delicious coffee drinks from fresh beans, exactly the way you like it, with the touch of a button. Automatic descaling for your convenience - it is easy to clean and maintain your coffee machine with the automatic program which notifies when you have to descale it. You can adjust the frequency of this procedure to match the water hardness at home. Adjust aroma strength and quantity via My Coffee Choice - adjust the strength and quantity of your beverage with the My Coffee Choice menu. Easily choose from three different settings to suit your preferences. Dishwasher safe parts for your convenience - for your convenience, you can put the milk system, drip tray and the coffee ground container in the dishwasher. This will save time and ensure a hygienic cleaning. Easy cleaning thanks to fully removable brew group - the brew group is the heart of every fully automatic coffee machine and should be cleaned regularly. The removable brew group allows you to clean it thoroughly just by rinsing it under the tap. Easy selection of your coffee with intuitive touch display - The irresistible taste and aroma of coffee from fresh beans is just one touch away. Our intuitive touch display allows you to easily select your favorite coffee. 20,000 cups of finest coffee with durable ceramic grinders - Bring out the full flavor of your coffee with our hard-wearing ceramic grinder. Our sharp-edged grinders extract the best aroma and flavor from your beans. Made from 100% ceramic material which ensures they last for at least 20,000 cups. Easily adjust to your taste with 12-step grinder levels - our durable ceramic grinders can be adjusted in 12 steps, so you can turn your beans into anything from ultra-fine powder to coarse grindings. The perfect temperature, aroma and crema cup after cup – the Aroma extract system intelligently strikes the optimum balance between brewing temperature and aroma extraction by keeping the water temperature between 194°F and 208°F, while regulating the water flow rate, so you can enjoy delicious coffees. Up to 5,000 cups without descaling thanks to AquaClean water filter* – by changing the filter after being prompted by the machine, you will not need to descale your machine for up to 5,000 cups**, while enjoying clear and purified water. *AquaClean filter compatible; not included. Sold separately. **Based on 8 filters replacement as indicated by the machine. Actual number of cups depends on selected coffee varieties, rinsing and cleaning patterns. WARNING: Cancer and Reproductive Harm. For more information go to: www.P65Warnings.ca.gov.
 
The Nuwave Dual Top Precision Induction Cooktop provides a safe and precise cooking experience with its innovative induction technology. With independent controls for each cooking surface, you can boil pasta on one side and simmer sauce on the other at the same time. Boasting 1800 watts of power and advanced programming capabilities, the Dual Top Precision Induction Cooktop can easily cook at temperatures ranging from 100°F to 575°F in precise 5°F increments. By cooking without any open flames or hot coils, the Dual Top Precision Induction Cooktop is incredibly safe with its shatterproof ceramic glass surface and automatic shutoff. 

Accessories Included:
  • User Manual
  • Recipe Book with 131 Recipes
  • Quick Start Guide


Product Features:
  • 6 temperature presets & 94 precise temperature settings between 100°F and 575°F
  • Two wattage selections: 900W & 1800W
  • Two 11.5” heat-resistant, shatterproof heavy duty ceramic glass cooking surfaces each with 25-pound weight capacity
  • 8” heating coils beneath each cooking surface for faster, even heating
  • Separate control panels with numeric keypad for each cooking surface
  • Warming function keeps foods warm at 155°F for up to 2 hours
  • Stage cooking capabilities along with built-in timer with up to 100 hours of memory
  • 50 preset recipes available at the press of a button, letting the cooktop do all the work along with 150 open memory slots lets you program and save your own custom recipes
  • Fahrenheit & Celsius temperature options
  • Automatic shutoff for safety


Dimensions & More Info:
  • 23.6” W x 14.1” L x 2.6” H
  • 14 lbs
  • 900W, 1800W
  • Induction-ready cookware required
  • Made in China

description: The MRCOOL 4th Generation DIY 18K BTU, 22 SEER Ductless Heat Pump system offers a complete solution to your home’s heating and cooling needs. With the included pre-charged 25 ft. line set, some hand tools, and a few hours of time this entire system can be completely installed. This system comes equipped with many functions that separate it from the rest. It has multiple operating modes, which include AUTO, HEAT, COOL, FAN-ONLY, DRY (dehumidification) and SLEEP. It also features the Follow Me function, which allows the system to continually adjust the room temperature based on where the hand-held remote controller is. nom: Lasko Ceramic Tower Heater with Remote Control
description: The Lasko Elite Collection Digital Ceramic Tower Full Room Heater, CT22495, with Remote Control is the perfect addition to any home during the cold winter months. This heater features 25% wider oscillation, providing full room coverage and ensuring that every corner of your room is warmed up. The safety features on this heater have been reimagined to provide maximum protection to you and your loved ones. The safety rollover design helps to prevent the heater from falling on its grill, while the child lock ensures that curious little hands cannot accidentally change the settings. The tip-over switch automatically shuts off the heater if it accidentally falls over. The touch sensing controls on this heater are not only easy to use but also provide an auto-dimming digital read-out, making it easy to monitor the temperature and settings. The heater has three heat settings: Low (750 W), Med (1300 W), and High (1500W), allowing you to choose the perfect temperature for your room. The 12-hour auto-off timer can be set in 30-minute increments (up to 2 hrs), providing a convenient way to turn off the heater when you are away or when you fall asleep. The AutoEco thermostat maintains room temperature while using less energy, making this heater an eco-friendly and cost-effective option for your home. The multi-function remote control provides added convenience and ease of use, allowing you to control the heater from anywhere in the room. The remote control also has on-board storage, making it easy to keep track of and preventing it from getting lost. The batteries for the remote control are included. Comes fully assembled with a 3-year limited warranty. description: Choose how you wash in this 3.8–3.9 cu. ft. Whirlpool® Top Load Washer with the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator. Easily swap the agitator in or out to care for clothes the way you want and get twice the washer you have at home. Choose the right amount of agitation for your fabrics with Soil Level Selection and get the water level you need for the cycle you want with Water Level Selection. Soak and wash in one cycle with Soaking Cycles and prevent fabrics from snagging with the Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket. 2 in 1 Removable Agitator The 2 in 1 Removable Agitator lets you choose how you wash and care for your clothes by easily swapping the agitator post in or out. With two ways to wash, it’s twice the washer you have at home. Soil Level Selection Choose the right amount of agitation for your fabrics with an option that lets you select the soil level of your load on any cycle, so you get less agitation on light loads and more on full or dirty loads. Soaking Cycles Soak and wash in one cycle. Skip a trip to the laundry room with Soaking Cycles that start washing whites and colors as soon as they're done soaking. Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket Help protect fabrics with this stainless steel wash basket that gently guides clothes during the wash. Water Level Selection Choose the water level you need for the cycle you want. No matter which wash cycle you choose, Water Level Selection lets you select Auto Sensing to adjust water based on load size or the Deep Water Wash Option to help break down loose soils with more water. 360 Wash Agitator Option Thanks to the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator, you can easily reinsert the agitator whenever you want to switch back from the impeller. Multiple wash motions gently move clothes up, down and side to side throughout the cycle for a thorough clean in different water levels. Smooth Impeller Option Easily remove the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator when your load needs a little more space to move. Impeller wash action cleans by rubbing the fabrics against each other, while the design of the impeller’s surface helps drive clothes from the outer rim to the center, where the deepest cleaning happens. 3.8-3.9 Cu. Ft. Flexible Capacity Keep the agitator in, or swap to the impeller to get the extra space you need to wash bulky items with this 3.8-3.9 Cu. Ft. Flexible Capacity washer. Quick Wash Cycle Your small, lightly soiled loads will be clean in as little as 30 minutes with the Quick Wash Cycle. Extra Rinse Option Ensure dirty loads get the care they need with an extra rinse to wash away any lingering soils or detergent. Whites Cycle Cleans loads of soiled white fabrics with the addition of bleach. An additional rinse helps to remove any remaining chlorine residue. Uses hot temperatures, fast tumbling, longer wash times and an extra-high spin speed for optimal cleaning. Colors Cycle Care for colored fabrics with a cycle that uses cold water to provide optimal fabric care. Bulky/Sheets Cycle The Bulky/Sheets Cycle takes care of bedding as well as those bulky winter jackets. The washer fills with enough water to wet down the load before the wash cycle begins, then uses a higher water level than other cycles. Delicates Cycle Clean your delicate items with an intermittent wash action and slow spin speed, to provide everything you'd expect for gentle fabric care. Clean Washer with affresh® Cycle Run the Clean Washer with affresh® Cycle every 30 washes with an affresh® washing machine cleaner tablet or liquid chlorine bleach to thoroughly clean the inside of your washer. Choose how you wash in this 3.8–3.9 cu. ft. Whirlpool® Top Load Washer with the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator. Easily swap the agitator in or out to care for clothes the way you want and get twice the washer you have at home. Choose the right amount of agitation for your fabrics with Soil Level Selection and get the water level you need for the cycle you want with Water Level Selection. Soak and wash in one cycle with Soaking Cycles and prevent fabrics from snagging with the Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket.

2 in 1 Removable Agitator
The 2 in 1 Removable Agitator lets you choose how you wash and care for your clothes by easily swapping the agitator post in or out. With two ways to wash, it’s twice the washer you have at home.
 
Soil Level Selection
Choose the right amount of agitation for your fabrics with an option that lets you select the soil level of your load on any cycle, so you get less agitation on light loads and more on full or dirty loads.
 
Soaking Cycles
Soak and wash in one cycle. Skip a trip to the laundry room with Soaking Cycles that start washing whites and colors as soon as they're done soaking.
 
Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket
Help protect fabrics with this stainless steel wash basket that gently guides clothes during the wash.
 
Water Level Selection
Choose the water level you need for the cycle you want. No matter which wash cycle you choose, Water Level Selection lets you select Auto Sensing to adjust water based on load size or the Deep Water Wash Option to help break down loose soils with more water.
 
360 Wash Agitator Option
Thanks to the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator, you can easily reinsert the agitator whenever you want to switch back from the impeller. Multiple wash motions gently move clothes up, down and side to side throughout the cycle for a thorough clean in different water levels.
 
Smooth Impeller Option
Easily remove the 2 in 1 Removable Agitator when your load needs a little more space to move. Impeller wash action cleans by rubbing the fabrics against each other, while the design of the impeller’s surface helps drive clothes from the outer rim to the center, where the deepest cleaning happens.
 
3.8-3.9 Cu. Ft. Flexible Capacity
Keep the agitator in, or swap to the impeller to get the extra space you need to wash bulky items with this 3.8-3.9 Cu. Ft. Flexible Capacity washer.
 
Quick Wash Cycle
Your small, lightly soiled loads will be clean in as little as 30 minutes with the Quick Wash Cycle.
 
Extra Rinse Option
Ensure dirty loads get the care they need with an extra rinse to wash away any lingering soils or detergent.
 
Whites Cycle
Cleans loads of soiled white fabrics with the addition of bleach. An additional rinse helps to remove any remaining chlorine residue. Uses hot temperatures, fast tumbling, longer wash times and an extra-high spin speed for optimal cleaning.
 
Colors Cycle
Care for colored fabrics with a cycle that uses cold water to provide optimal fabric care.
 
Bulky/Sheets Cycle
The Bulky/Sheets Cycle takes care of bedding as well as those bulky winter jackets. The washer fills with enough water to wet down the load before the wash cycle begins, then uses a higher water level than other cycles.
 
Delicates Cycle
Clean your delicate items with an intermittent wash action and slow spin speed, to provide everything you'd expect for gentle fabric care.
 
Clean Washer with affresh® Cycle
Run the Clean Washer with affresh® Cycle every 30 washes with an affresh® washing machine cleaner tablet or liquid chlorine bleach to thoroughly clean the inside of your washer.

Prewash clothes right inside this top load washer using a built-in washing machine faucet to help remove loose soils or select the washing machine Presoak Option to soak and wash in one cycle. Once you choose a cycle, the 360 Wash Agitator works to help provide a thorough clean.

Built-In Water Faucet
Easily prewash clothes and other items right in the washer with a conveniently located faucet that gives you easy access to an instant water stream to remove loose soils.

Presoak Option
Save a step by soaking and washing in one cycle. The Presoak Option starts washing your laundry after a 30 minute presoak.

Deep Water Wash Option
Get more water to help break down loose soils. This option automatically adds more water to your load, so heavily soiled clothes get an optimal clean. (Bulky Items Cycle only available with deepest water level.)

Smooth Impeller
Give clothes a thorough yet gentle clean. Designed so clothes have more room to move, the surface and vanes also help drive clothes from the outer rim to the center, where the deepest cleaning happens.

Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket
Help protect fabrics with this stainless steel wash basket that gently guides clothes during the wash.

Lid Lock
Unlock the lid any time simply by pressing the Start/Pause button. The lid automatically locks when the load sensing phase begins, at which point the Lid Lock icon on the console is illuminated.

4.6 cu. ft. Capacity
Get the extra space you need to wash bulky items with this 4.6 cu. ft. capacity washer.

Quick Wash Cycle
Your small, lightly soiled loads will be clean in as little as 30 minutes with the Quick Wash Cycle.* (*Based on a 3-lb load)

Extra Rinse Options
Two Extra Rinse options help ensure that messes and detergent are thoroughly rinsed away. Add it to heavily soiled clothes and loads with fabric softener to achieve an optimal clean.

Clean Washer with affresh cycle
Run the Clean Washer with affresh Cycle every 30 washes with an affresh® washing machine cleaner tablet or liquid chlorine bleach to thoroughly clean the inside of your washer.

The Electrolux front load washer provides the most effective stain removal with SmartBoost premixing technology. Features like Optic Whites and Perfect Steam provide better care for fabrics, giving your favorite clothes a longer life.

Features
  • The most effective stain-removing washer with SmartBoost - Unlike other washers, our washer with SmartBoost premixes water and detergent before the cycle begins, maximizing the cleaning power of the detergent, giving clothing a longer life.
  • Optic Whites cycle keeps whites whiter than bleach - Keep your white clothing and linens looking newer longer with our Optic Whites cycle which prevents the redeposit of dirt and other residues, keeping whites whiter than the normal cycle with bleach.
  • Pure Rinse option rinses cleaner - Remove detergent residues and fragrances that can irritate skin with Pure Rinse which rinses cleaner than our extra rinse option without using more water.
  • 15-Minute Fast Wash - Quickly deep clean the items you need most.
  • Thorough cleaning with the LuxCare Plus Wash System - Our LuxCare Plus Wash System offers a thorough clean with even distribution of detergent and additives, improved wash actions, temperature control and smart load sensing.
  • StainSoak option eliminates pre-treat - Unlike other washers, StainSoak starts by premixing water, detergent, and stain remover before the cycle begins to create a powerful, yet gentle cleaning solution. Then, the temperature, tumbling actions, and time are optimized based on the stain you select.
  • Remove bacteria with the Sanitize setting - Certified to kill and remove 99% of bacteria.
  • Remove allergens with our Allergen option - Remove 95% of allergens from your clothing, towels and bedding with our NSF - certified Allergen option.
